## Usage and evidence

Configuration fragments accept only fields defined by the current schema. Plugin option schemas are registered in their owning namespace during bootstrap.
Unknown fields cannot bypass validation through a global ignore switch; old flat configuration is not read.
Input, ABI, semantics, cache and publication requirements are described in the guide. Schema coverage is not invocation or distribution certification.
